metadata.title: शिल्पी नेहा तिर्की पेसा, लैंडबैंक और सरना पर क्या बोलीं |  Interview with Shilpi Neha Tirkey
metadata.description:
In this exclusive interview with Main Bhi Bharat Editor Shyam Sunder, Jharkhand Cabinet Minister and young tribal leader Shilpi Neha Tirkey opens up on key issues impacting tribal communities. From the implementation of the PESA Act to the controversial Land Bank policy and the long-standing demand for recognition of the Sarna religion, she shares her candid views and political vision.

The daughter of senior Congress leader Bandhu Tirkey, Shilpi Neha represents a new generation of tribal leadership—vocal, grounded, and determined to protect tribal rights and identity.

📌 Don't miss this in-depth conversation on tribal rights, governance, and the future of Adivasi politics in Jharkhand.

🔔 Subscribe to Main Bhi Bharat for more interviews and ground reports on India’s tribal communities.
